newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish crown firms, debt market keeps strength.
newsitem.headline: Swedish crown firms, debt market keeps strength.

text.p: The Swedish crown firmed further in Thursday morning trade and debt yields maintained their early strength.
Dealers said the crown was supported by a large purchase by a big Swedish bank but added that the lack of a recoil following the deal supported the local unit.
"We tested a recoil yesterday but that did not really happen. Now that we have tried the upside we are testing the downside," one dealer said.
One dealer said the crown could firm to 4.32 crowns to the mark in the next couple of days, mainly for technical reasons.
In morning trade the crown firmed to 4.3390 to the mark versus 4.3610 late Wednesday.

Yields were lower with dealers saying the crown and falling U.S. yields were giving strength to the debt market. The ten year bond yield was six basis points lower at 6.48 percent on Thursday morning and one dealer said it could fall to 6.40 percent in the short term. Six month T-bill rates fell three basis points to 4.23 percent.
The Riksbank was holding a board meeting by letter today but no policy decisions were on the agenda.
